conventions.frame: window-origin ego frame at t0; x forward, y left, metres, clip-local
conventions.gap: along - size_x/2 (rig origin to lead REAR face); NOT bumper-to-bumper
conventions.selection: strictly causal, <= t0, staleness <= 0.5s, |lat| < 2.0 m, gap <= 80.0 m, classes ('automobile', 'heavy_truck', 'bus', 'other_vehicle', 'trailer')
conventions.NOT_STRAIGHT: the ego's own future path leaves the same |lat| < 2.0 m corridor within the range claimed (the lead gap when there is a lead, else max_gap_m). A straight band cannot describe the lane through a bend, and scoring it as NO_LEAD would manufacture free flow. Non-causal by design: label derivation may use ego.
conventions.NO_LABEL: no obstacle.offline for the clip, or the window leaves the labelled span. NEVER counted as free flow — that would manufacture empty road.

states.LEAD: causal in-corridor vehicle ahead at t0, future track present
states.NO_LEAD: labels present, straight, road clear within 80 m
states.NOT_STRAIGHT: ego's own future path leaves the corridor within the claimed range — its own state, never NO_LEAD
states.NO_LABEL: no obstacle.offline for the clip / horizon leaves the labelled span — NEVER free flow

speed_check._is: max |dump v0 - block speed at the joined row|: both are egomotion interpolated at frame 2t, so this is the label-free proof the join hit the right clip and frame

coverage.join_key: (clip_id from the dump manifest, RAW frame 2t from ws)
coverage.note: NO_LABEL / no-row / refused-episode windows are counted here and NEVER scored as free flow; NOT_STRAIGHT is its own state (a bend hides the lead outside the corridor)
